mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic contraction intensifies.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), persistent inflation accelerates expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts signals strengthening consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (5% below 2017 base) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate output declines.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payrolls and rising unemployment signal labor market collapse, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as recession fears dominate market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by >0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales decline exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when RSAFS declines by >0.5%.
